name: libjpeg-turbo (on iOS)
baseline: ImageIO JPEG decoding (Apple's AppleJPEG path) behind UIImage(data:)
verdict_reason: libjpeg-turbo's 2-6x claim is against libjpeg, which is not what iOS uses for JPEG. On an iPhone 6 an independent test found Apple's AppleJPEG path in ImageIO usually 1-2x the speed of libjpeg-turbo, so bundling it to decode JPEG faster than the system is not supported.
tier_reason: Independent measurement by a third-party developer with public test code, but from 2015 on an iPhone 6 with no OS or build details.
claimed_speedup: libjpeg-turbo: 'generally 2-6x as fast as libjpeg'. On iOS (iPhone 6): AppleJPEG encode/decode speed usually 1~2 倍 (1-2x) that of libjpeg-turbo, so libjpeg-turbo is at best equal to the default.
workload: Encoding and decoding test photos on an iPhone 6 with ImageIO (AppleJPEG) and with libjpeg-turbo.
one_liner: SIMD JPEG codec 2-6x faster than libjpeg, but measured no faster than ImageIO's AppleJPEG on iPhone.
how_it_is_fast: libjpeg-turbo rewrites libjpeg's color conversion, IDCT and upsampling with SIMD (NEON on ARM) and speeds up Huffman coding. That beats libjpeg's scalar C, but ImageIO on iOS routes JPEG through Apple's AppleJPEG, which the benchmark author says uses the chip's hardware codec and falls back to libjpeg only when that fails.
use_it_when: You need JPEG features ImageIO lacks, such as lossless transforms (jpegtran) or exact control of encoder parameters
Cross-platform C code that must behave identically on iOS, Android and servers
skip_it_when: Speeding up JPEG decoding in an iOS app: the only iOS measurement found puts ImageIO ahead
You want hardware-assisted decoding and lower battery use
caveats: 2015 iPhone 6 measurement; no newer iOS comparison was found
The 1-2x figure is a summary sentence; per-image numbers are in chart images
The 2-6x claim is relative to libjpeg on desktop and server CPUs, not to ImageIO
The '1~2' text spans two HTML elements on the blog page
tradeoffs: Adds a C library and a CMake build to the app
GitHub does not detect the license (NOASSERTION); the code is under the IJG, BSD 3-Clause and zlib licenses

evidence.quote: libjpeg-turbo is generally 2-6x as fast as libjpeg, all else being equal.
在我的测试中，其编解码速度通常是 libjpeg-turbo 的 1~2 倍。
